title: 天皇賞（春）の後に・光風霽月

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Symboli Rudolf has reclaimed her honor after the exhibition race, but she has no intention of stopping here. She sets her sights on the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But this time, she isn't putting herself under as much pressure. She even has enough free time to enjoy a trip to a teahouse with me.
